confidence.rationale: Deterministic extraction from repository policy files.

procedure: - Read `PBP Surgical training/AGENTS.md`, its project `skills.md`, source catalog, and manifest.
- Use MarkItDown caches before article analysis.
- Treat OpenEvidence as secondary navigation and preserve A/B/C evidence labels.
1. Hash and cache every incoming source before moving it.
2. Identify bibliographic metadata from article content and rename unique PDFs `{LeadAuthor}_{Year}_{short_title}.pdf`.
3. Record exact and DOI/title duplicates before retaining copies under `Research papers/_duplicates/`.
4. Regenerate the manifest, evidence inventory, and one evidence card per unique article.
5. Update the primary-source crosswalk; keep absent cited papers explicitly unverified.
6. Update the 12 synthesis products in order, mapping evidence before designing gates or dependencies.
7. Keep technical proficiency distinct from clinical entrustment and PGY/time distinct from competence.
- 2026-08-31: Initial 27-article corpus, two retained same-article duplicates, OpenEvidence crosswalk, benchmark/learning-curve registries, and 12-part curriculum synthesis.
rollback: Keep the record as candidate or delete it before promotion.
